verdict.rationale: Conductor runs coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode) in isolated workspaces, each with its own branch, files, terminal and diff review. Work can be started from plain-language prompts or directly from GitHub and Linear issues, then reviewed, opened as a PR and merged. The actual code generation comes from the underlying third-party agents, used with your own subscriptions or keys. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of multi-file feature or bug implementation quality, and independent hands-on corroboration of successful multi-file fixes.
